feeds.title: wake up and smell the humans
feeds.description: Hi, and welcome to my blog. I'll be upfront here and confess that I haven't got much of a clue about what's really going on in this world but I am, like many of us, a very curious animal. I endeavor to be well informed, so I observe the world and read a lot. Then I get up at 4.22 am and write. Lately, I have been finding that writing fiction is working well for my sanity. I start in the dark and before you know it the sun's up and everything's groovy.
